title: The Double Border
author: Jude Kavanagh
blurb: Oscar Eastwick, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
